description.value: Main Street Brewing is a craft microbrewery and taproom in Vancouver's Mount Pleasant neighbourhood, pouring an eclectic lineup of pilsners, IPAs, lagers, sours, and small-batch 'Garage Series' specialties brewed on-site. The taproom doubles as a retail store where cyclists can pick up canned beer to take on the road, and an in-house kitchen serves food most days. The brewery's Main Street Premium Pilsner earned a gold medal at the 2024 Canadian Brewing Awards, and an ongoing 'Tunnerman's True Cask Ale' program offers traditional cask-conditioned pours.
